_comment: Seed channels. Resolved once in Phase 0 and VERIFIED against a stated
subscriber count. Never re-resolve these by name: searching the string
'Nate Tokens' returns a different human (Nate B Jones, 309k subs) at rank 0.
New channels enter the system only video -> channel_id, never name -> channel.
stats_asof values are the Phase 0 measurements the 5x drift guard compares to.
